A striking anime-style digital painting of a young adult woman sitting in a compact, knees-raised pose, viewed from a slightly elevated frontal perspective. She wears an oversized, vivid golden-yellow hooded jacket with a large voluminous hood framing her head, loose folded fabric and broad angular folds. Her long, tousled blue-black hair falls across her forehead and shoulders, with subtle cobalt-blue highlights. She has pale gray-blue eyes, soft pinkish skin tones, and a quiet, slightly melancholic expression. A black inner garment is visible beneath the loose yellow jacket, with one shoulder partially exposed.

Her bent knees occupy the lower foreground, creating pronounced depth and foreshortening. A nearly white, uncluttered background with a few restrained blue-gray painterly accents.

Preserve an expressive hand-painted anime illustration aesthetic: bold, economical brushstrokes, irregular painterly edges, layered opaque color shapes, simplified yet intentional shading, strong yellow-versus-blue contrast, and restrained surface texture. Keep the visual design clean without excessive microdetails, artificial sharpening, or photorealistic textures.

Follow the supplied depth control map for the seated body pose, silhouette, knee placement, perspective, and overall spatial arrangement.

photorealistic rendering, 3D render, plastic skin, hyper-detailed textures, excessive hair strands, dense fabric patterns, unnecessary ornaments, noisy brushwork, overly smooth airbrushing, exaggerated glossy highlights, busy background, extra limbs, duplicated knees, broken anatomy, incorrect foreshortening, distorted face, muddy colors, unwanted text, watermark
